يفتليان (form VIII)
# يَفْتَلِيَانِ (yaftaliyāni) /jaf.ta.li.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
# يُفْتَلَيَانِ (yuftalayāni) /juf.ta.la.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
